zh: 截断差分：只预测部分输出差的差分。
部分差分：输出差中可预测的那一部分。
高阶差分：在子空间上取高阶导数（异或和）。
选择明文：攻击者选择明文并获得密文。
差分传播：输入差如何影响输出差。
en: Truncated differential: a differential that predicts only part of the output difference.
Partial difference: the predictable part of an output difference.
Higher-order differential: a higher-order derivative (XOR sum) over a subspace.
Chosen plaintext: the attacker selects plaintexts and obtains ciphertexts.
Differential propagation: how an input difference affects output differences.
